data.content_ref: inline:conn:204d29004328 CONTRADICTS SRC_002's constant-residue shortcut: SRC_002 claims x≡-2 mod 5 and x≡-2 mod 7 ⟹ x≡-2 mod 35, yielding 33. But 4≡-3 mod 7 (not -2), so the residues relative to moduli are unequal (-2 vs -3) and the shortcut produces a value (33) failing the mod 7 check (33 mod 7 = 5 ≠ 4). The correct CRT answer is 18, which the shortcut cannot reach. This contradiction is REFUTED IF the constant-residue shortcut can be modified to handle unequal residues—i.e., if there exists a generalization of the common-residue heuristic that correctly yields 18 without modular inversion.
